role: exposed post-validation ceiling diagnostic; not development selection, validation, or confirmation
fixed_estimator: Huber reg0.1 cap8 with frozen public scales; previously failed development selection

record_reweighting.definition: multiply each selected record quality by (minimum final group service rate / its group final service rate)^alpha
record_reweighting.oracle_selection: post-hoc per-world minimum worst-group RMSE; ceiling diagnostic only

h6_ceiling: serve every participant or every timely-arrived distinct user/group pair; no deliberate withholding of better-served groups
decision_rule: Only design a new cross-layer policy if both the no-withholding H6 ceiling and fixed-estimator H7 record-reweighting ceiling meet their original margins. Otherwise produce a quantitative obstruction certificate and architecture requirements.
reuse_rule: All seeds and outcomes are already exposed; results cannot be called independent validation. No confirmation seeds may be opened.
